input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Down Home"?

documents.text: Down Home (Chet Atkins album) Down Home is the nineteenth studio album by American guitarist Chet Atkins. After releasing the smooth pop and easy listening albums "Chet Atkins' Workshop" and "The Most Popular Guitar", Chet returned to his roots with "Down Home". The album peaked at No. 31 and returned Atkins to the Top 40. It includes two of Chet's signature tunes, "Windy and Warm" and "Trambone". Writing for Allmusic, critic William Ruhlman wrote of the album "The contrast from his previous secular release couldn't have been more dramatic...
